about: What the talent app collects, derived from the code (repositories under lib/src, the SDKs in pubspec.yaml). The source for the Play Data safety form, the App Store privacy labels and ios/Runner/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy; docs/store-privacy.md explains each answer. test/store/data_safety_test.dart fails when a dependency or an iOS data type is missing here.

data.what: The account's phone number (sign-in) and an emergency contact's phone number (profile).
Display name and the emergency contact's name.
Barterly account id (tags crash reports) and the Instagram handle on the profile.
Instagram handle, a way to reach the person outside the app.

apple.label: Contact Info: Other User Contact Info

data.what: Date of birth, bio, home city (typed, not device location), languages, skills, talent type; the result of the optional ID check (the ID and selfie themselves are captured on the KYC provider's page, not by the app).
UPI ID, or bank account number and IFSC, to pay stipends out. Sent to the payment provider; never kept on the phone.
One location reading when the person opens a check-in pass and agrees, to show the host the distance to the property. Never in the background.
Chat messages with hosts (and photos attached to them).

apple.label: User Content: Emails or Text Messages

data.what: Photos and videos the person picks or takes for applications, deliverables and chat.
Application notes, reviews and replies, hours notes, deliverable post links and their reported stats, report and decline reasons.
Saved gig searches (filters and a name) for new-match alerts.
The device's push token, once the person allows notifications.
Crash reports with stack traces (Sentry), tagged with the account id, never the phone number.
Device model and OS in crash reports, and rooted/jailbroken-device signals (reported, never blocking).

not_collected.Email address: The app never asks for one (the web console may).
not_collected.Approximate location: Only the typed home city, declared under Other info.
not_collected.Contacts: add_2_calendar's iOS location field may suggest contacts inside the system sheet; the app never reads them.
not_collected.Calendar: add_2_calendar opens the system calendar with an event filled in; the app never reads the calendar.
not_collected.Audio: Sound is only part of videos the person adds.

sdks.add_2_calendar: Opens the system calendar with an event; reads nothing.
sdks.connectivity_plus: Network on/off, on the device only.
sdks.crypto: Check-in pass codes (TOTP), computed on the device.
sdks.dio: HTTPS client for the Barterly API.
sdks.firebase_auth: Phone number sign-in (Google, as processor): phone_number.
sdks.flutter_map: Map tiles from the tile server (IP address and the map area, as any web request).
sdks.flutter_secure_storage: Sign-in tokens in the Keychain/Keystore, on the device only.
sdks.google_fonts: Downloads the Inter and Space Grotesk fonts from Google Fonts on first launch (the request carries the IP address, like any web request); nothing about the person.
sdks.image_picker: Camera and photo picker: photos_videos, files.
sdks.package_info_plus: The app's own version, for the update check.
sdks.path_provider: App folders for picked files, on the device only.
sdks.shared_preferences: Offline feed and queued applications, on the device only.
sdks.url_launcher: Opens links and the KYC provider's page in the browser.
